history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

default.description: Compatibility alias for experiments recorded before the mode cutoff (2026-11-10, borg-zoo#54): settings {}, so every mode stays on the build's own default - and borg_munchkin_by_class defaults TRUE only from better-borg-c fd683ced (PR 302). The same profile name is a different game on either side of that commit, so default is NOT comparable across it: an experiment that touches a post-cutoff better-borg-c specimen must name a mode profile (normal, munchkin-class, munchkin-on, lunal) instead; plan rejects default there. Experiments recorded before the cutoff keep default under their "pre_cutoff" note.

neo-fork-e731c81.label: The Neo Borg from diegoami/neo-angband-borg-mod-tracker master e731c81 (upstream port a10655c3 plus the fork's accepted repairs), on the Neo engine at the fork's recorded baseline 06a2321c, built and run by the tracker toolkit at 2668adc5 through its official API2 host adapter. The toolkit's hard-coded source pins are replaced by this specimen's own (toolkit_pins: follow-specimen); the toolkit's patches were reviewed against the 5a9cab20 / 014c8104 pair, so the build and play are checked by a smoke run before any claim. Not Mandos.

classes-18.description: Every class twice: 18 fresh seeds, 100,000 engine turns, classes dealt and races cycled as in classes-1800. A smoke suite for assigned births.

experiment.description: Build and play check of the Neo Borg from diegoami/neo-angband-borg-mod-tracker (e731c81) through the tracker toolkit with its source pins following the specimen. classes-18, default profile. Says only whether it builds and plays; not a comparison.
experiment.name: neo-fork-smoke
